review:
Sweet Bonanza introduced the pay-anywhere tumble format years before Gates of Olympus made it ubiquitous, and it still plays well. The candy presentation is bright and light, but the math is not: the base game pays mostly fruit and small tumbles, and nearly all of the real potential sits in the free spins.

Unlike Gates, multipliers in Sweet Bonanza do not persist across the bonus – each tumble sequence is assessed on its own. That makes individual spins in the bonus more exciting and the round as a whole a little less predictable. The 21,175x max win is far higher than the original Gates.
pros: High max win for its age
Bombs in every free spin keep the bonus lively
cons: Multipliers do not persist between spins
Base game rarely produces meaningful wins
